WITH store_yearly AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) AS store_1998_total,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) AS store_1999_total
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) > 0
       AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) > 0
       AND SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) > 0
),
web_yearly AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) AS web_1998_total,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) AS web_1999_total
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) > 0
       AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 + 1) > 0
       AND SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998) > 0
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id,
       t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
       t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
       t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM customer c
JOIN store_yearly sy ON c.c_customer_sk = sy.ss_customer_sk
JOIN web_yearly wy ON c.c_customer_sk = wy.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           1998 AS dyear,
           's' AS sale_type,
           sy.store_1998_total AS year_total
) t_s_firstyear ON true
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           1998 + 1 AS dyear,
           's' AS sale_type,
           sy.store_1999_total AS year_total
) t_s_secyear ON true
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           1998 AS dyear,
           'w' AS sale_type,
           wy.web_1998_total AS year_total
) t_w_firstyear ON true
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           1998 + 1 AS dyear,
           'w' AS sale_type,
           wy.web_1999_total AS year_total
) t_w_secyear ON true
WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998
  AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
  AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998
  AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
  AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total ELSE 0.0 END
      > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id,
         t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
         t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
         t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
